$comment: Pairs the current tokens fail that the owner hasn't decided on yet. Each is a FINDING for the owner: the look is the owner's, so values are not changed until the owner decides. The check reports these and does not fail on them; it fails on any other failure, and on an entry here that no longer fails. When the owner decides, change the token (or the pattern) and take the entry off. Stage 1's five findings (alerts without an edge, Console dark's busiest heat cell) were decided on 2026-11-20 and fixed in 0.1.0 (--alert-edge, --heat-0-fg..--heat-4-fg). In 0.1.1 the owner took the alert edge off again: an admin alert is its --warn-bg fill only, which isn't an edge and isn't measured (like --border dividers), so it is not a finding.
